cookbooks.title: Getting Started with Rig + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Use the rig-redis vector store crate to connect a Rig agent to Valkey for high-performance KNN vector similarity search.

cookbooks.title: Vector Search with Rig + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Insert documents with embeddings, run KNN queries with top_n and top_n_ids, apply score thresholds, and wire vector search into a Rig RAG agent.

cookbooks.title: Filters & Production
cookbooks.lead: Use RediSearch filter syntax for metadata filtering, combine filters with AND/OR/NOT, and configure rig-redis for production with connection management and TLS.
